sources.text:
Pull request #101: feat(history): search conversations by Frame name
Merged: 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- 1a2b3c4 feat(history): search conversations by Frame name (#101)

Closes #99.

History search only matched message text. This adds a **Frame** filter to the History search bar: choosing a Frame shows only conversations that used it. The filter list shows Frames installed in the current Hubspace.

## Verification
- unit tests for the filter reducer pass

sources.title: fix(connectors): keep the Google Drive connector signed in after restart
sources.text:
Pull request #102: fix(connectors): keep the Google Drive connector signed in after restart
Merged: 2026-05-05T14:30:00Z into main
Commits from this pull request in the release range:
- 2b3c4d5 fix(connectors): keep the Google Drive connector signed in after restart (#102)

After a restart the Google Drive connector showed **Reconnect** even though the token was still valid. The connector now reuses the stored session on startup, so it stays signed in after Collab restarts.

Tested on macOS and Windows. Linux was not tested.
